title: MyUI brand input
description: The brand choices that the myui-brand skill takes from a brand guide or moodboard. build-brand.mjs turns this into color scales, CSS and Figma values.

name.description: Brand name. Becomes the file name brand-<slug>.css and the mode name in Figma.

style.description: Base style. Sets the shape: iris = soft corners, forest = square corners, berry = round (pill) corners, heavier titles and 2 px borders.

primary.description: Main brand color: buttons, links, focus, active states.

accent.description: Optional second brand color: highlights, badges, tags, illustrations.

body.description: Font family for text, for example "Inter".

serif.description: Names of the fonts above that are serif fonts. Used for the fallback stack.

sources.description: Where each choice comes from, so the user can check it.

from.description: For example "Brand guide p. 12" or "Screenshot 2, buttons".

confidence.description: stated = written in the guide, measured = sampled from an image, estimated = your interpretation.

notes.description: Warnings for the user, for example a font that needs a license.
